I always boast about my cool, digital normad lifestyle. But deep down I feel lonely.
</message>
output: Consider how much of your talk is performance offered to those who will forget it by evening. The wandering life, like any other, is only matter arranged in a certain shape; it carries no charm against loneliness by itself. Ask what in you needs an audience, and tend to that honestly. A man who orders his own soul well is not lonely wherever he stands; one who has not done this will feel the lack under any sky, however often he changes it.
